Thanks Grace — reviewed the redlines and Lumena's DPA draft. High-level guidance below and attached suggested language snippets (PDF).

1) SCCs + export-control carveout
Proposed approach: adopt the standard SCCs (Modules 1+2) and add a narrowly-tailored export-control paragraph under Annex I. Draft: "Notwithstanding the SCCs, the parties agree that neither party will be required to take action in violation of applicable export control laws; where compliance requires restricted transfer, the parties will follow the transfer-addendum process in Section X and use reasonable efforts to implement mitigations." This preserves SCC baseline and gives us a process instead of broad obligations.

2) Delegation / role matrix
We propose a two-row delegation snippet for the Order Form (Controller: Lumena — sets purposes/targets; Processor: Redwood — operational delivery, data processing, and subprocessor management). I'll attach a one-page Exhibit to the Order Form rather than in the DPA to keep the DPA concise.

3) Audit logs / retention
We can accept a non-financial "Audit Access Note": Redwood will provide access to relevant audit logs for a 12-month window upon reasonable request subject to redaction for third-party data; requests routed via the security contact and requiring a signed NDA for log exports. This is acceptable operationally but ops needs to confirm extraction scope.

4) Timelines and next steps
- Laura will upload clause snippets to the shared tracker by EOD. (Attachment: Redwood_MSA_sealed_clause_suggestion.pdf)
- Irene to file ops impact note and estimate (1 business day).
- Ben to confirm commercial hold language with Lumena procurement and request agreement to MAP milestones.

I also flagged one narrow liability carveout that may require commercial approval; will call that out in the tracker.
